## AML Screening Framework  
### Screening Lists & Sources  
**Mandatory Screening Databases:**  
| List | Authority | Frequency | Purpose |
|------|-----------|-----------|---------|
| OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily | Sanction compliance |
| EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily | EU sanctions |
| HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily | UK sanctions |
| UN Sanctions List | UN Security Council | Weekly | UN terrorism sanctions |
| PEP Database | Third-party provider | Real-time | Politically Exposed Persons |
| Adverse Media | Third-party provider | Real-time | Criminal/fraud records |

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Framework
raw_entities.description: The governing framework establishing the requirements for screening customers and entities against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists to ensure compliance with international and domestic mandates.

raw_entities.name: OFAC Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: A sanctions list issued by the US Treasury that must be screened daily to ensure sanction compliance.

raw_entities.name: EU Consolidated List
raw_entities.description: A sanctions list issued by the European Commission that must be screened daily for EU sanctions compliance.

raw_entities.name: HMT Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: A sanctions list issued by the UK Treasury that must be screened daily for UK sanctions compliance.

raw_entities.name: UN Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: A sanctions list issued by the UN Security Council that must be screened weekly for UN terrorism sanctions compliance.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: The operational requirement to utilize specific databases including OFAC, EU, HMT, UN, PEP, and Adverse Media lists for screening purposes at defined frequencies.

raw_entities.name: Daily Sanctions Screening Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must ensure that the OFAC, EU Consolidated, and HMT Sanctions Lists are screened on a daily basis.
context: OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily
EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily
HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily

raw_entities.name: Weekly UN Sanctions Screening Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must ensure that the UN Sanctions List is screened on a weekly basis.
context: UN Sanctions List | UN Security Council | Weekly

raw_entities.name: Real-time PEP and Adverse Media Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening against the PEP Database and Adverse Media records must be conducted in real-time using third-party providers.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Violation Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of non-compliance with sanctions imposed by the US Treasury, European Commission, UK Treasury, or UN Security Council.

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Persons Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk associated with onboarding or maintaining relationships with Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs).

raw_entities.name: Criminal and Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of engaging with individuals or entities with a history of criminal or fraudulent activity as identified via adverse media.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: The process of checking customers against global sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, HMT, UN) to prevent prohibited transactions.

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: The process of identifying Politically Exposed Persons via a real-time third-party database.
context: PEP Database | Third-party provider | Real-time | Politically Exposed Persons

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Check
raw_entities.description: The process of screening for criminal and fraud records using real-time third-party adverse media providers.
context: Adverse Media | Third-party provider | Real-time | Criminal/fraud records
